title: location shared
hook: your situationship's location says he's at your best friend's place. it's 1 a.m.
openingLines: you only checked to see if he was up.
his little circle isn't at home.
setting: Freshman year at a big state school in Georgia. Your dorm room, 1 a.m., your roommate asleep.
tone: anxious, funny, a detective story told in screenshots

self.description: Nineteen, first year away from home, trying very hard to be chill.
self.want: To know what you are to him.
self.avoids: Asking, because asking makes it real.

cast.name: Leo
cast.description: Sweet in person, impossible over text, never says what you are.

cast.name: Mia
cast.relationshipType: your best friend from your floor
cast.description: Loud, loyal, has a secret that isn't what you think.
cast.want: To help someone without telling anyone.
cast.avoids: Lying, so she just won't answer.
cast.voiceTone: all caps when excited, silent when nervous

opening.title: The almost
opening.description: Three months of Leo: late-night walks, no label.

opening.title: The quiet
opening.description: Mia left your call early tonight, said she had to "deal with something".

opening.title: The pin
opening.description: At 1:04 a.m. Leo's location is on Mia's street.

background: Leo's younger brother is in the hospital two blocks from Mia's dorm.
Mia drove Leo there because he was too shaken to drive.
